commits.message:
Make dependency builds independent of the temporary directory path

libfuse is built with debug info, so the random mktemp path ends up in
libfuse3.a and, through static linking, in the runtime's debug info,
build ID and .gnu_debuglink CRC. Two builds of the same build
environment therefore yield different runtime binaries.

Map the path to a fixed one using -ffile-prefix-map. With this change,
separate builds produce bit-identical runtime and .debug files (tested
for x86_64 and i686).

Refs #133

files.patch:
@@ -18,20 +18,23 @@ this_dir="$(readlink -f "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")"
 
 cd "$tmpdir"
 
+# keep the random tmpdir path out of the debug info, it would end up in the runtime's build ID
+prefix_map_flags="-ffile-prefix-map=$tmpdir=."
+
 wget https://github.com/libfuse/libfuse/releases/download/fuse-3.15.0/fuse-3.15.0.tar.xz
 echo "70589cfd5e1cff7ccd6ac91c86c01be340b227285c5e200baa284e401eea2ca0  fuse-3.15.0.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -
 tar xf fuse-3.*.tar.xz
 pushd fuse-3*/
 patch -p1 < "$this_dir"/../../patches/libfuse/mount.c.diff
 mkdir build
 cd build
-meson setup --prefix=/usr ..
+CFLAGS="$prefix_map_flags" meson setup --prefix=/usr ..
 meson configure --default-library static
 ninja -v install
 popd
 
 # Minimize binary size
-export CFLAGS="-ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Os"
+export CFLAGS="-ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Os $prefix_map_flags"
 
 wget "https://github.com/vasi/squashfuse/archive/0.5.2.tar.gz"
 echo "db0238c5981dabbd80ee09ae15387f390091668ca060a7bc38047912491443d3  0.5.2.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
